evals.prompt: Crea una lección para principiantes sobre while en lessons/while-practica.html. Ya conocen variables, operadores y condicionales. Usa un ejemplo de inventario y termina con un ejercicio sin solución.
evals.expected_output: One offline Spanish HTML deck with a concrete inventory example, an accurate while flow, incremental Java, and an exercise.
assertions: The first explanation shows a concrete situation before loop terminology or syntax.
The diagram checks the condition before the body, visibly returns to the condition, and has a distinct exit.
Names, quantities, condition, updates, and expected results agree across the diagram and code.
The exercise visibly includes an objective, starting point, constraints, and expected outcome without a complete solution.
The output passes static validation and works offline.
At 1366x768 and 1280x720, essential content is readable and does not overlap the controls.

evals.prompt: Amplía la sección de métodos de lessons/java-poo.html con una explicación visual de parámetros y argumentos para principiantes. Conserva el ejemplo del pedido y el orden del curso. No cambies otras secciones.
evals.expected_output: A narrowly scoped extension of the methods section that preserves its running example and curriculum sequence.
assertions: The agent reads the existing methods section and surrounding slides before planning edits.
The visible explanation distinguishes a parameter from the concrete argument supplied by a call.
The declaration, call, values, and result agree with the existing order example.
A diff shows no unrelated section changes or curriculum reordering.
The complete edited deck passes static validation; browser checks and unverified items are reported separately.
